messages:
mina: Kicking off Quix customer's LoRA merge (quix-lora@0.7) into staging for compatibility + quant triage. Scope: token-map check, CSV line-item aggregation tests, int4-calib vs int8, and a quick shadow serve. tagging @otto for quant ops

otto: on it. please upload the eval pack (need csv receipts + conversion cases). I'll run token map and a preliminary baseline.

mina: Uploaded pack to gs://redwood-evals/quix/quix-mini-2026-03-23.tar.gz 80 convs, 25 CSV receipts, 20 currency micros (values in cents/micros).

eval-bot: queued job job_112233 on pool=dedicated-staging. baseline (adapter no-quant) will run first. logs: http://ci.internal/jobs/job_112233/logs

otto: Token diff first. Run: python infra/token_map_diff.py --base open-7b --adapter quix-lora --out /tmp/quix-token.json

charlie: FYI quix uses "INVNUM" and often sends amounts in micros (e.g., 123456 -> $1,234.56). We've seen int4 collapse magnitude when mixed with soft-prompts. Recommend baseline without soft-prompt, then full adapter.

mina: Baseline done: money-f1=0.981, csv-agg-accuracy=0.995, p50lat +7ms. Token diff: remapped=5, oovs=2 (INVNUM, MICROS). Patched remap to INV_NUM and MICROS_amt.

eval-bot: int4-calibrated run (perchannel, calib=2048, quant-opt=clamp-scale) complete: money-f1=0.92, csv-agg-accuracy=0.88, observed magnitude collapse on ~6/25 CSV receipts. int8 run complete: money-f1=0.98, csv-agg-accuracy=0.992. report: http://ci.internal/reports/quix/job_112233/report.html

charlie: Paste a failing CSV aggregation example please.

mina: Failing example:
Prompt: CSV lines: "item,qty,unit_cents
A,2,123456
B,1,50000
Total due?"
baseline: "USD 2,959.12"
int4: "USD 295.912"  (decimal/magnitude shifted)

otto: Interesting 10^n scaling bug. Looks like quantized logits for small-value tokens got shifted during soft-prefix composition. Try int4 perchannel asymmetric + clamp-scale and increase calibre to 8192. Also run a cache-disabled long-thread subset.

mina: Relaunching int4-highcalib job with calib=8192, perchannel-asymm, quant-opt=clamp-scale, long-thread cache disabled. seed pinned=20260323.

ops-bot: Canary route created: route=quix-numeric-safe -> int8-artifact, threshold=money-f1<0.95 on last-30 evals.

eval-bot: rerun complete: int4-highcalib: money-f1=0.975, csv-agg-accuracy=0.987, long-thread diffs reduced. Artifacts archived gs://redwood-artifacts/quix/job_112234.tar.gz

otto: Good fix. Recommendation: ship two artifacts: int8 (default for numeric-critical customers) and int4-highcalib (cost-optimized, recommended with clamp-scale). Add release note about MICROS token remap and soft-prompt scaling caveat.

charlie: I'll open ENG-ML-4822 for adapter author to review soft-prefix scaling and ensure CSV-driven tokenization is stable. Attach failing prompts and run metadata.

mina: Done. Closing loop after 12h staging bake. Thanks all :thumbsup:
